consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: injury during start-up after maintenance on P-8302

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EXPOSURE_MONITORING: the monitoring of airborne contaminant exposure had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control REAGENT_HANDLING_CONTROL: the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control RESPIRATORY_PROTECTION_PROGRAM: the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-8302, M-8302 and PT-8302 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled make-up, decanting and dosing of reagents on P-8302, M-8302 and PT-8302 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the selection, fit testing and maintenance of respirators on P-8302, M-8302 and PT-8302 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling airborne contaminants, specifically selecting, fit-testing and maintaining respirators. P-8302 (reagent dosing pumps) is in service for reagent make-up and dosing. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 18 October 2010 an incident occurred on P-8302, M-8302 and PT-8302 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during start-up after maintenance, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
